craft_notes: Sthāyin: crowning-joy (emperor, sun). Sanskrit first: return + manner + double predicate → L4 sets return line 1, crowns line 2. Rows: row 1 (dark-last — dhvānta closes as dark closes). Rupture: dash after behind — return done, reign stated. Close: end-weight on darkness-sunned. Minimal pass: 'twoness' for abheda-negation (duality-absence sung). Read aloud: back, without, king, sun. Rejected: 'non-dualistically' adverb — killed: adjective-state kept; 'monarch' — killed: emperor plain (samrāj).

lines: Turned home to self-awareness, twoness left behind —
he stands king of the yoked, sun to ignorance-dark.
l4.sanskrit_cite: paryāvṛttaḥ svasaṃvittau vartate yas tv abhedataḥ / sa samrāḍ yogayuktānām ajñānadhvāntabhāskaraḥ

reads_against.argmap: Turned back into self-awareness without duality, he is emperor of yogins, sun to ignorance-darkness.
c1_essence: Turned back without duality: emperor, sun to ignorance-dark.
